# Lectio API (full)

Lectio API is a Revised Common Lectionary API, liturgical calendar API, Book of Common Prayer Daily Office API, and Catholic lectionary API. It is a free, open-source REST service at https://lectio-api.org (MIT license). Repository: https://github.com/asachs01/lectio-api.

## What are today's lectionary readings?

Call `GET https://lectio-api.org/api/v1/readings/today?tradition=rcl`. Add `tz=America/New_York` (the default) or another IANA time zone so "today" is the civil date in that zone, not UTC. The response includes Sunday or special-day lectionary readings when they exist, plus Morning and Evening Prayer readings from the BCP Daily Office.

Example:
`curl "https://lectio-api.org/api/v1/readings/today?tradition=rcl&tz=America/New_York"`

## What RCL year is it?

The Revised Common Lectionary uses a three-year Sunday cycle (A, B, C) that changes on the First Sunday of Advent, not on January 1. Mid-2025 is Year C; Advent 1 on 30 November 2025 begins Year A. Ask `GET https://lectio-api.org/api/v1/calendar/current?tradition=rcl` or pass a date to `/api/v1/readings`.

## Book of Common Prayer Daily Office

The BCP 1979 two-year Daily Office lectionary (Year One and Year Two) also flips at Advent 1. Year One begins at the Advent 1 preceding odd-numbered civil years. Use `tradition=bcp` or the daily office endpoints.

## Catholic lectionary

Use `tradition=catholic` on the readings and calendar endpoints for the Roman Catholic lectionary.

## Episcopal / Anglican

`tradition=episcopal` combines RCL Sunday readings with the BCP Daily Office on weekdays.

## MCP

Connect over Streamable HTTP at https://lectio-api.org/mcp (health check: https://lectio-api.org/mcp/health). The source package is `mcp-server/` in the GitHub repository.

Canonical tools (shared params: `date` as YYYY-MM-DD, `tz` as an IANA zone defaulting to America/New_York, `tradition` as `rcl`, `catholic`, `episcopal`, or `bcp`):

- `get_readings` — today (omit date), a single date, or a startDate/endDate range
- `get_calendar` — current season and cycle, a civil year, seasons, special days, upcoming holy days, feast lookup, or factual context for a date
- `list_traditions` — tradition metadata
- `search_lectionary` — search by season or feast name (there is no scripture-reference search)

`explore_calendar` and `analyze_liturgical_context` are deprecated aliases for one release. Resources: `lectionary://today`, `lectionary://readings/{tradition}/{date}`, `lectionary://calendar/current`, `lectionary://traditions`. Prompts: `prepare_sermon_readings`, `prepare_daily_office`, `explain_liturgical_day`.

## FAQ

Longer answers live at https://lectio-api.org/faq and in docs/FAQ.md in the repository.
